regions.region: page 1 title, author block, keywords, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and DOI from the original rendered page; author/keyword metadata contains no experiment-specific operation or outcome.

regions.region: page 1 graphical abstract and Comprehensive Summary
regions.finding: The displayed methylation/rearrangement is an aggregate generic current reaction class with generic R1/R2 groups and '19 examples; up to 75% yield'. It is linked to the current generic Scheme 1d record rather than treated as one scope experiment or assigned a specific row yield.

unresolved: The graphical abstract does not provide experiment-specific quantities, temperature, time, individual product identity, or yield basis.

regions.finding: Classified Tian, Song, and Zhang panels as three cited prior-literature reaction classes; none was promoted to a current-paper experiment or given an invented current yield.
Classified the dipropargylamine/MeOTf methylation-rearrangement arrow as the current generic reaction class; concrete optimization and scope runs are represented separately.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion and Table 1 reaction header/entries 1-14/footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization rows independently with 2a 0.5 mmol, row base identity/amount, solvent 2 mL, row temperature/time, isolated yield, and entry-14 nitrogen atmosphere. The table's base mmol values and narrative equiv wording are both retained as a source-unit conflict.

unresolved: Table 1 reports base in mmol while the narrative calls selected identical numeric values equivalents; no arithmetic correction was imposed.
Entry 9 is 0.6 mmol in the table although the prose groups entries 8-9 under a statement about 0.8 equiv.
Workup, purification, product masses, and detailed isolated-yield method are absent.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 2 reaction header, products 3a-3q, caption and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded all seventeen displayed scope products as independent one-pot experiments. Each has separate 0 °C/20 min MeOTf methylation, explicit Et2O-removal operation, and 65 °C/6 h t-BuOK rearrangement, with row isolated yield targeted to its product.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left continuation of Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: Linked the 65%/55% temperature results, 23%/40% time results, and 51% nitrogen result to existing Table 1 entries 10-14 rather than creating duplicate experiments.

Recorded the EtOTf sequence as one two-stage experiment: 25 °C/20 min ethylation gives an isolated ammonium-salt intermediate in 92%, followed by t-BuOK/toluene at 65 °C for 6 h to product 4 in 60%. The 92% value remains a stage yield.

Recorded the unsymmetrical ammonium-salt rearrangement as one experiment giving regioisomers 5 and 5'. The scheme image prints 41% combined yield while the adjacent narrative states 42%; both values and evidence are retained.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits atmosphere, ether-removal time/temperature, workup, purification, and product masses.
Scheme 3a omits absolute charges/volumes and yield bases.
Scheme 3b has an unresolved 41% image versus 42% narrative combined-yield conflict and does not report regioisomer ratio.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 4 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified salt 2, ylide A, and five-membered transition state B as a plausible mechanism leading from 1 to 3; A/B are proposed species, not preparations.

regions.region: page 4 conclusions, Supporting Information statement, acknowledgments, and references 1-10
regions.finding: Conclusions and administrative text add no experiment. The online SI statement does not establish a workspace SI association. Bibliographic prior work was not expanded into current-paper records.

unresolved: Proposed intermediates A/B have no independent observation status or quantities.
The publisher SI link is not an explicit workspace association and no SI-only fact was imported.
